validation_rules: notNull(type_lnd|NOT_APPLICABLE);notEmpty(type_lnd|NOT_APPLICABLE);matchList(type_lnd, {'NW','NS','NE','Non-Vegetated Water', 'Non-Vegetated Snow/Ice', 'Non-Vegetated Exposed Land'}, FALSE,FALSE,TRUE,FALSE|NOT_APPLICABLE);yvi01_nat_non_veg_validation(type_lnd, class, landpos,cover_type)
description: Checks type_lnd is not empty and is in 'NW','NS','NE'. Then checks either landpos is 'A', or class is in 'R','L','RS','E','S','B','RR'. Translation converts landpos A to ALPINE, and 'R','L','RS','E','S','B','RR' to 'RIVER','LAKE','WATER_SEDIMENT','EXPOSED_LAND','SAND','EXPOSED_LAND','ROCK_RUBBLE'.
Checks type_lnd is not empty. Checks type_lnd is NU, and class is RD, G or T. Maps  RD/Road to FACILITY_INFRASTRUCT, G/Gravel Pit to BORROW_PIT and T/Tailings to INDUSTRIAL.

validation_rules: notNull(type_lnd|NOT_APPLICABLE);notEmpty(type_lnd|NOT_APPLICABLE);matchList(type_lnd, {'VN','Vegetated Non-Forested'}, FALSE,FALSE,TRUE,FALSE|NOT_APPLICABLE);matchListTwice(class, cl_mod, {'S','H','C','M'},{'Tall Shrub', 'Low Shrub', 'Tall Shrub Open', 'Tall Shrub Closed'}, FALSE,FALSE,TRUE,FALSE)
description: Checks type_lnd is not empty. Checks type_lnd is VN, and class is S, H, C or M. Converts cl_mod of TS, TSo, TSc, LS to TALL_SHRUB, TALL_SHRUB, TALL_SHRUB, LOW_SHRUB. And classes of C, H and M to BRYOID, HERBS and HERBS.
